points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean f06ea3f source builds in restricted cfd-bench with bundled dependencies; all three CTests pass (unit and two mesh-inspection tests).

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/inspect and restart; output.cpp:280–296 stores step, physical time, current and previous states in rank-local files. Restart requires the original MPI count.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates config, mesh, partition, physics, solver and output; report records future extension limits.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable wrapper found; external authorship/similarity investigation was not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp loads JSON case configuration and CGNS mesh paths; no two-filename-only case branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:121–132 partitions on root, distributes then resets all global partition objects before solve. METIS/neighbor halos and rank evidence exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: State positivity scaling and error checks exist; no production rerun or independent stress campaign was performed.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Three clean CTests pass: unit and NACA/cylinder mesh inspections; no unsteady solver rerun. Historical validator and rank packages are preserved.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is organized; curated report omits escaped PNG assets despite an accepted original workspace PDF.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
